reasoning.step1:
Plan:
- Confirm this is an invoice (presence of "Rechnung", invoice number, dates, totals).
- Locate requested fields in the text and extract exact values without guessing.
- Prefer sender VAT from invoice issuer (CREATON GmbH) over buyer's VAT.
- Preserve decimal precision and convert comma decimals to dot for numeric fields; remove percent symbol for VAT rate.

Field-by-field extraction evidence:
- Document type: invoice (header "Rechnung", invoice number, totals present).
- Invoice.Date: "Datum 22.09.2023" → "22.09.2023".
- GrandTotal.Amount: "Zahlbetrag 180,36 EUR" → 180.36.
- Net.Amount: "Gesamtbetrag Netto 155,73 EUR" → 155.73.
- Vat.Rate: "R2 - 20,00% USt auf 155,73" → 20.00 (per rule return number without %).
- Vat.Amount: "31,15 EUR" shown as VAT for that group → 31.15.
- Sender.VatId: footer lists "Ust.-ID-Nr. ATU69710958" for CREATON GmbH (invoice issuer) → "ATU69710958".

No inference used beyond mapping text to fields; if any field were missing, it would be left empty.
reasoning.step2:
Invoice.Date — Confidence: High
- Evidence: Explicit "Datum 22.09.2023" under invoice header.

GrandTotal.Amount — Confidence: High
- Evidence: "Zahlbetrag 180,36 EUR" clearly labeled as payable amount.

Net.Amount — Confidence: High
- Evidence: "Gesamtbetrag Netto 155,73 EUR" explicitly shown.

Vat.Rate — Confidence: High
- Evidence: Line "R2 - 20,00% USt auf 155,73" shows 20,00% VAT rate for the invoice; extracted as 20.00 (no percent sign).

Vat.Amount — Confidence: High
- Evidence: Corresponding VAT value shown as "31,15 EUR" on the same VAT line.

Sender.VatId — Confidence: Medium
- Evidence: Footer lists "Ust.-ID-Nr. ATU69710958" for CREATON GmbH (company header matches invoice issuer). Medium confidence because the invoice also shows "Ihre Ust-Id-Nr. ATU64131246" (customer VAT) elsewhere; selection of issuer VAT is based on footer company identification.
